hook: Hussain Sagar's Yacht Club wins a *World Sailing* award
hook_b: Hussain Sagar's Yacht Club wins a *World Sailing* award
tldr: The Yacht Club of Hyderabad won the 2026 World Sailing 11th Hour Racing Impact Award in Qingdao on Wednesday. Its free programme gives children from low-income families sailing training, equipment, transport, education and nutrition.

beats.what: The Hussain Sagar-based club won World Sailing's 11th Hour Racing Impact Award.
beats.why: The award recognises marine sustainability work; the club also cites helping restore Hussain Sagar.
beats.care: Sailors from the programme have gone on to the armed forces and sailing careers, the club says.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 19): the trophy is made from recycled carbon fibre from an America's Cup boat.

cards.q: Would you try sailing at Hussain Sagar?

qs: What would it take for more Hyderabad lakes to host free water sports?

facts.t: It is the *first* time an Indian organisation was even shortlisted for this World Sailing award, the club says.

viz.l: Medals won by the club's sailors since 2014
viz.verdict: Free programme for children from low-income families

watch: Whether the award brings new funding or seats in the club's programme.

fact: Yacht Club of Hyderabad wins World Sailing's *2026* Racing Impact Award in China
twist: Its free programme has trained 2,000+ children since 2014, winning 323 national medals.
